scope: MDS only; one Apple M3, 10 GPU cores, 16 GiB
basis: Full million-round local chain-work equivalents; not pool-estimated hashrate. GPU remains at 90% requested duty; hybrid adds four fully active CPU search workers.

sourceAudit.nonceDomains: GPU below 2^63; CPU upper half, eight-aligned shared cursor

changes.cpu: NEON byte-table/shift-insert rotations and explicit seven-round schedule
changes.hybrid: One pool session, disjoint nonce domains, bounded output, shared job cancellation and joined workers
changes.default: GPU-only remains the default; this tested Desktop profile is configured for GPU + four CPU workers.

comparison.B: signed packaged 0.1.16 GPU + four CPU workers

cpuInstructionScreen.note: 45-second single-thread candidate between old-code controls; this is CPU-only throughput, not a GPU gain.

screening.decision: Reject grouped GPU submissions: an early 711 N/s run was followed by a collapse, including later baseline measurements. Root cause not proven. Retain original GPU scheduling. Concurrent-process sums use separately timed loops and are only screening; the single-process production ABBA is authoritative.

limits: Only this M3 was measured; no all-M or multi-day guarantee.
CPU assistance uses more CPU resources; no power-efficiency measurement.
Offline verified results are not pool acceptances.
App is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID notarized.
privateRawEvidence: .local/mds-opt3 and authorized M3 session/mds-opt3; research binaries must never ship.
thermalObservation: macOS thermal state progressed from 0 (nominal) to 1 (fair). Second hybrid run averaged 715.816 versus first 731.473 N/s; no constant 724 N/s long-term claim.
